message.content: I'll fetch and inspect that WebP image.

A deep Norwegian-style fjord valley seen from a rocky, lichen-flecked crag in the foreground. Steep green mountain walls plunge toward a winding blue-green river/lake that snakes through the valley floor, edged by bright green meadows. Distant ridges fade into blue haze, with patches of snow on high slopes. The sky is bright blue with thin, wispy white clouds. Trees appear as dense dark-green forest blanketing the lower slopes and valley sides.
